T: Last day of camp. First night of snacks.
D: The counsellors at a 1981 summer camp try to sort out their love lives on the last day before everyone goes home.
P: Serve the snacks when the last day at Camp Firewood begins.
S: Gene the cook talks to a can of vegetables
Roasted mixed vegetables tossed with herbs, a better use for the vegetables Gene keeps talking to.
Toasted marshmallows and chocolate squashed between biscuits around the fire. Toast 16 marshmallows until golden.
M: Saucy beef mince in soft buns, camp cafeteria food from the summer of 1981. Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp brown sugar and simmer 15 minutes.
W: Last day bug juice ice blocks
Frozen fruit punch ice blocks, the camp drink frozen solid for a hot summer day.
K: Red fruit cordial mixed with water and plenty of ice, the classic camp drink.

s.note: Gene the cook talks to a can of vegetables
s.how: Toss 2 zucchini, 1 capsicum, 2 carrots and 1 red onion, chopped, with 3 tbsp oil and dried herbs. Roast at 210C for 30 minutes until golden.
Toast 16 marshmallows until golden. Sandwich each with a square of milk chocolate between 2 plain biscuits. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Brown 500g beef mince with 1 onion and 1 capsicum, add 200ml tomato sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 1 tbsp brown sugar and simmer 15 minutes. Spoon into 6 soft buns.

w.n: Last day bug juice ice blocks
w.how: Mix 500ml tropical juice with 300ml lemonade and freeze in ice block moulds for 5 hours. Serve it at the halfway point of the film.

d.how: Mix 200ml red fruit cordial with 1.2L cold water in a big jug and serve over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
